ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a path map of Typhoon “Haikui”, with multiple time data labels on the path. Among them, the label at 17:00 on August 6 reads “970hPa, 33m/s”, and the label at 17:00 on August 7 reads “960hPa, 40m/s”. Then reason: The question asks how the maximum wind force near the center changed, so only the wind speed items are extracted for comparison. At 17:00 on August 6 it was 33 m/s, and at 17:00 on August 7 it was 40 m/s. 40 m/s is greater than 33 m/s, so from August 6 to 7 the maximum wind force near the center of Typhoon “Haikui” increased.
